snippet.title: Look Outside - Full Game Walkthrough (No Commentary) - All Endings
snippet.description:
Look Outside is a survival horror RPG and action‑adventure game dripping with cosmic horror - this no‑commentary walkthrough shows every secret and boss fight in crisp pixel detail.

Explore every floor of the apartment building, encounter grotesque neighbors warped by an eldritch event. Master the turn‑based combat mechanics by exploiting enemy weaknesses and recruiting warped neighbors as allies.

Developed by Francis Coulombe and published by Devolver Digital, Look Outside combines richly detailed pixel art with an unsettling ambient soundtrack to deliver a tense survival experience. Discover hidden lore entries in secret rooms and piece together the origin of the catastrophic event that corrupted your neighbors. 

Watch until the end to see every ending variation and unlock all secrets.
